reviews.text: Jose helped me a lot with a package. He's wonderful. I love this store for the service and everything they have :)
Both Jesús and the girl who works there are great with the parcel service, they always help me :) thanks
The staff are very friendly and helpful. It's a small shop, but it has everything my pets need.

Thank you so much for the thoughtful gift of some extra treats for my dog. She loved them.
They have a great selection of chew toys and natural food.
Very nice pet shop and good dog groomers. Great people.
Excellent product quality and top-notch service!
Excellent and they are always very kind

Excellent service ALWAYS! Jesús is a wonderful person, very pleasant, friendly, and attentive. You can tell he loves our furry friends by the care he gives them. You can find everything for them, and he always has a smile. I also have to mention the "little girl" (a new addition to the team), who is pure sweetness. Highly recommended!!!
The best place for my little love of my life :) Thanks for all
Very friendly service, they always give me a free treat with my purchase. They always have what I'm looking for and at a good price. 🙂 …
Excellent service and attention! I recommend it 100%.
The service was very friendly and they were very gentle in their handling of the pets.
One of the best shops to buy food, sweets, toys, ... plus they are always lovely and have a hairdresser.
They're always super nice!!
Phenomenal inpost service
Excellent service and products
My go-to shop in Malasaña for buying food and other supplies for my dog. I've been going there for years and I still think they have very high-quality products and offer excellent advice.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! This shop has everything you need, and they take great care of our little ones when we take them to the groomer… both Jesús and Patricia are excellent professionals and always attentive to their customers. 🫶 …

I only managed to buy something once because, frankly, their opening hours are very limited. I went by on a Saturday at 10:30 and they were closed. I went back the same Saturday at 2:10 pm and they were closed again. It turns out they're only open from 11 am to 2 pm...
Terrible service! Poor customer service, no answers.
best pet shop in Madrid!! so nice, helpful and kind! always giving me treats for my cat after buying different things i needed

I want to highlight Jesús's excellent service; he's always attentive to my needs and tries to make everything easier for me. And I also want to mention Patricia, who bathes my dog ​​with so much love and makes her look beautiful. I highly recommend them! Thank you!
Good selection of products, friendly and caring staff with pets.

I've been taking Miky to the dog groomer for a long time, and they always do a fantastic job.

‼️ They treat him wonderfully ‼️ 🤗
They're so cute. Yesterday they clipped my dog Prana's hair, and she looks gorgeous. Great service, great vibes. We'll definitely be back! (Oh! And a great price, too!). Thanks, guys!

The owner is very friendly and always greets you with a huge smile. We take our dog there for a bath and she always comes out VERY, VERY clean :) There's a great variety of products in the shop! Highly recommended!
Jesús and Edu are true professionals! Highly recommended, and they've made the place look beautiful.
The person who serves is super friendly.
A small store with really nice and helpful team.
Dog grooming and everything you need for your pet
